sources.title: Ergon Energy Zone Substation Load Data 2025-26
known_gaps: Archive provides historical half-hourly load, not rated/firm capacity or guaranteed connection headroom.
Published numeric MW/MVA labels appear systematically inconsistent with magnitudes; raw values are retained and interpreted /1000 fields remain explicitly sampled rather than source-certified.
Substation coordinates and DAPR capacity/forecast attributes still require join to Ergon network/DAPR records.

datasets.provenance: Ergon Energy Network Zone Substation Load Data 2025-26 authoritative ZIP archive
datasets.blocker: Entity completeness reconciled 265/265. Numeric load scale remains sampled; historical load must not be treated as connection capacity.
